reddit.title: Improved Music Transitions in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the music system in Provincia! Now, instead of hard cuts between day, night, title, and combat music, we have implemented a smooth crossfade that enhances the listening experience. This means no more jarring transitions, just seamless audio that keeps you immersed in your colony-building journey. Check out the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

steam.title: Soft Music Reloops Update
steam.body: We are excited to announce the latest update to Provincia that improves the music experience! The transitions between day, night, title, and combat music are now smooth thanks to a new crossfade system. This means you can enjoy uninterrupted audio while building your colony. For more details, visit: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
